verdict: Organic presence is holding; GBP activity softened across all three locations.
narrative: Across Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision, no paid advertising ran during the last 28 days — every action recorded came from organic Google Business Profile presence. Combined, the three locations delivered 371 GBP actions (directions, calls, and web clicks), which reflects real local search demand without any paid support behind it. The most pressing movement this week is a sharp late-period drop in GBP actions at both Advance Grinding and O'Hare Precision, with each showing zero profile activity over the final four days of the window — this is being investigated now to determine whether it reflects a visibility change or a data delay. O'Hare Precision's organic search clicks held steady, up 5% week-over-week, which confirms that search intent remains active; the goal for next period is to ensure that interest is being captured and routed properly.

watch_item.fix: Profile visibility is being reviewed at both locations this week to identify any listing changes or indexing issues and restore normal activity levels.
